notes: Mabad speaks in the first person plural («قال اجتمعنا ناس») and relates a visit to Anas; the saying is Anas's hadith quoted inside the scene (rule 6 unsettled, so Anas is not added)
The later Hasan al-Basri episode («فقال لقد حدثني») is not read as a route here
«يا أبا حمزة» and the visitors are scene only
